observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show a black PlayStation 4 console with a 'Star Wars' theme sticker on top.
The console has 'SONY' and 'PS4' branding visible on the front.
Two controllers are placed on top of the console; one is silver/gray, the other is black.
The controllers appear to be DualShock 4 style, with standard layout and buttons.
The console is placed on a wooden surface, with a yellow metal object and plastic bag in the background.
The console shows some smudges and minor wear on the surface, but no visible damage to the casing.
No games are visible in either photo.
The seller claims it includes 13 games, but no games are shown or listed.
